        r'^\w+,\s\w+$',  # Two words separated by comma and space
        r'^[A-Za-z\s]+\s[A-Za-z\s]+\s\w+\s?\d+$',  # Address with name, number, and optional suffix
        r'^[A-Za-z-]+\s[NS]?[EW]?\.?\s[0-9]*\s[stStNdNtThThRdRd]\s?([A-Za-z]{1,2})?$',  # English road name format
        r'^[\w\s]+,\s\w+\s\w+$', 
        r'^[A-Za-z\s]+\s\w+\s\w+$',  # Three words separated by spaces
        r'^\d+\s[A-Za-z]+',  # Number followed by word (like '955')
        r'^(Mr|Mrs|Miss|Dr)\.\s\w+$',  # Title followed by a full name
    ]

        if re.match(pattern, cell):
            return False

        return True
    non_english_patterns = [
        r'^[A-Za-z]+\s+[A-Za-z]+[^\w\s]+',  # Mixed character set indicating non-English or dirty formatting
        r'^[^\w\s]+[\w\s]+[^\w\s]+',  # Mixed character set indicating non-English or dirty formatting

    if cell in dirty_cells:
        return True
